items.title: One Mount Etna eruption took weeks. Another happened in hours
items.title_en: One Mount Etna eruption took weeks. Another happened in hours
items.title_zh: 埃特纳火山的一次喷发持续了数周，另一次则仅在数小时内就发生了
items.summary_en: Mount Etna’s ancient eruptions followed radically different paths, with some magma lingering near the surface for weeks while other magma raced upward from nearly 30 kilometers deep in just hours. Scientists traced the difference to volcanic gases such as carbon dioxide and water, offering a powerful new way to understand and potentially anticipate explosive eruptions.
items.summary_zh: 埃特纳火山在远古时期的喷发方式截然不同：有些岩浆会在地表附近滞留数周，而另一些岩浆则能在短短数小时内从近30公里深处急速喷发至地表。科学家将这种差异归因于二氧化碳和水等火山气体，这为理解甚至可能预测爆炸性喷发提供了一种强有力的新途径。

items.title: Back-to-back Arctic storms can double sea ice loss
items.title_en: Back-to-back Arctic storms can double sea ice loss
items.title_zh: 接连不断的北极风暴可能使海冰损失量翻倍
items.summary_en: Scientists have found that Arctic cyclones become especially destructive when several strike one after another. These storm clusters cause about twice as much sea ice loss as isolated cyclones, with impacts that persist roughly two and a half times longer. As Arctic ice becomes thinner and weaker, the damage from these storms appears to be increasing, potentially creating a feedback loop that accelerates future ice loss.
items.summary_zh: 科学家发现，当多个北极气旋接连袭来时，其破坏力会尤为剧烈。这些风暴群导致的海冰损失量约为孤立气旋的两倍，且其影响持续的时间约为孤立气旋的2.5倍。 随着北极海冰变得越来越薄、越来越脆弱，这些风暴造成的破坏似乎正在加剧，这可能会形成一个反馈循环，从而加速未来的冰层消融。

items.title_en: Extreme-Scale Linear-Scaling Kohn-Sham DFT at 100 Million Atoms: Bridging Quantum Simulations and Experiments

items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13115v1 An: new Abstract: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) remains the workhorse of ab initio materials simulation, yet cubic computational and quadratic memory scaling have confined calculations to a few hundred to thousands of atoms, spanning only na: a 200-million-atom silicon crystal, twentyfold beyond the prior record. Our implementation achieves 96.6% weak-scaling efficiency and sustained 157.9 Pflop/s (FP64) for a 100-million-atom scaling study. We further simulate an 11-million-atom all-solid-state battery interface of unprecedented complexity, 1,000 times beyond prior DFT for such systems, revealing how lithium metal reacts with the solid electrolyte at atomic resolution, in quantitative agreement with spectroscopy experiments.

items.summary_en: Ancient rocks from Western Australia suggest water was reaching deep inside Earth more than three billion years ago, long before modern plate tectonics may have fully developed.
